original: The babies! My babies have been\nkidnapped!
The kidnapped babies are Botamon,\nPunimon, and Yuramon.
So the babies were safe after all!\nBut... why were they here?
No matter how you look at it, this\ndoesn't seem like kidnapping.
Anyway, we should go back to the\nVillage of Beginnings.
What on earth were you doing? I\nwas so sure you had been\nkidnapped...
Um, they said Elecmon's always\ntaking care of them, so...
...they wanted to sing a song to\nthank him, and had been practicing\nit in secret.
You wanted to sing for me.\nAaaaaaaah! My babies!
Seems like they all like you,\nElecmon.
Takeru! Patamon! Guys! I'm so\nsorry for causing all this\ntrouble!
Takeru! I'm sorry, thank you so\nmuch! Here, take this!
Are you sure? Thank you, Elecmon!
You're welcome to come back and\nsee the babies' faces again!
Takeru can just pick one right\nup...
It's a baby! There's one here,\ntoo!
How sweet. I wish I could make\nfriends as easily as Takeru can...
The babies! We have to help them\nright away!
If you rub it, a Digimon will\nhatch!
But Mimi, we have to find the\nkidnapped babies.
All right, let's keep looking for\nthem.
